reviews.title: iPhone Duo optimization
reviews.text: I will come back and give ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ once Nanit optimizes the app for iPhone Duo because I love Nanit

reviews.title: Requires subscription
reviews.text: Do not buy this product. In order to use your camera you need to sign up for a 100 dollar per year subscription. Complete lack of transparency when purchasing the product

reviews.title: Money grab. Pathetic.
reviews.text: The features are nice, I’ll give them that. I think it’s absolutely horrible of them to charge PER CAMERA for a subscription. I have two under two and am being charged an arm and a leg for features that, honestly, should just be built into such an expensive product in the first place. Product costs $200ish depending on your bundle, then you have to spend HOW MUCH to actually use the most helpful features? Feels like exploiting new parents who just want security, watching over their kids. It angers me to no end.

reviews.title: Money Grab
reviews.text:
Everything is behind a paywall. 
My 720p Logitech monitor has better video quality than my, supposedly, 1080p Nanit.
I wouldn’t gift a Nanit monitor to my worst enemy. 
Terrible product. Terrible company. Terrible app

reviews.title: Absurd
reviews.text: It’s insane that a camera app for a baby needs this complicated of a password. And also that it needs my phone number and email JFC I’m sure they’re probably selling my # just so I can have this app my wife wants me to have F this scammy App.

reviews.title: Bad product worse service
reviews.text:
The product itself is bad. It is very finicky and difficult to connect, especially on hotel WiFi.

Also they force you into a free trial of their $30/month subscription before you can use the app, then make it very difficult to cancel.

Terrible business practices.

reviews.title: Decent but subscription model is awful
reviews.text:
I’d suggest looking elsewhere for a nanny cam. The subscription model here is awful, price gouging for basic features.

I wouldn’t recommend this app due to the cost and limiting items.

reviews.title: Predatory subscription
reviews.text: First of all, you cannot set up your device unless you choose one of their paid subscriptions, despite their claim the camera can be used without one. Trying to then cancel the “free trial”subscription before it bills you is the most frustrating experience. You can only upgrade your subscription via the app, there is no cancellation option. To cancel you must login through a browser. They make it easy to take your money, but not stop it. It’s a roach motel, easy to get in but impossible to get out. I’m mad that I’ve committed to using this company to monitor my baby.

reviews.title: Mandatory subscription for each camera
reviews.text: I pay for one $200 annual subscription for my oldest 19 months and we just had a baby not too long ago and if you want all the same features you have to pay for a new subscription. I’m ok with paying for the additional features but the exact same rate for a second subscription? What new parent wants to pay $400 a year? This is already double what a Netflix annual subscription would cost at $108

reviews.title: Phone battery killer - No camera scheduler
reviews.text:
After years of requesting it and hundreds spent with Nanit devices, there is still no on/off scheduler.

Your phone just streams the camera in the background all day, destroying battery life, for no reason unless you unplug it or go in and manually turn the camera off every morning and back on later.

They are just trying to burn out the hardware or nag you to engagement. It’s user hostile. What an absurd thing to still not have done. Put a Christmas lights timer on it and never buy from them again.

reviews.title: Struggles to pair in hotel rooms.
reviews.text: Never pairs when visiting hotels. Very annoying.

reviews.title: Crazy subscription pice
reviews.text: Crazy to be charging +$100

reviews.title: Disconnect of Camera
reviews.text: Very frequent disconnects of the camera. Customer support isn’t too helpful. Wouldn’t recommend

reviews.title: terrible
reviews.text: it never works half the time

reviews.title: Ads on monitor screen
reviews.text: New update has ads on the monitor screen advertising subscription to nanit. Very distracting when monitoring a child. Should have an option to remove. Shame on you nanit!!!!

reviews.title: Buffering
reviews.text: This thing is constantly buffering and never loading video. I’m using the HelloBaby monitor more than this. I am not renewing the subscription when it expires.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: It’s expensive app, sucks that when we have our 2nd baby we will have to pay 2 subscription, the camera isn’t all that accurate and half the time doesn’t record my baby’s naps even though I watched the camera and saw it saying “hey mom I fell asleep min ago” it’s a good camera but just a few hiccups.

reviews.title: Attention Tech Team
reviews.text: Do better!  But seriously…kind of embarrassing that you would even publish this app.

reviews.title: GARBAGE
reviews.text: I’ve had nothing but issues with Nanit. If you’re looking at these reviews to decide if you should spend hundreds and hundreds and dollars and then hundreds of dollars just to use it, DONT!!!! It constantly logs me out then won’t give me the option to log back in so I have to reset my password DAILY almost. The interface is not user friendly. It constantly disconnects from wi-fi. I’d rather use an old school monitor than this.

reviews.title: Decent Product. Bad iPad app
reviews.text:
People want to monitor their babies on a screen. You'd think the Nanit iPad app would be a company priority. You would be wrong. 

Entire paid features like video history and insights are not reachable in the app. The iPhone app has a multi-tab navigation that is perplexingly missing entirely on the iPad for no apparent reason. I nearly refunded my subscription thinking I had been scammed. 

The app also falls apart in multi-window mode, even if you keep the app in Fullscreen and never resize it. I have to minimize and maximize 2-3 times to actually see the feed. 

Nanit, give some love to your iOS developers and fix your product.

reviews.title: SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED AND DATA PRIVACY RED FLAGS
reviews.text:
You know what is absolutely disgusting for a company to do? Force you to sign up for a subscription (free trial or paid for) just to use their product. 

What if you don’t want to use the trial and just want to use the product you already paid for? TOO BAD. 

What’s worse, is the trial routes you through a website to force sign up before you can use the app with your product, and going to the company website to try and login and cancel it gets you nowhere.

There FAQ is out of date, and the in-app help is just AI that is completely useless.

Guess how you cancel your subscription? You have to go to my.nanit.com to login and then cancel your subscription. 

How this is legal in the USA is ludicrous and hope this company gets sued into oblivion for this deceptive practice, as I know our European counterparts do not tolerate such shady behavior.

Outside of their terrible initiation flow, Nanit has terrible data collection policies that are remarkably dystopian. 

Their CEO wants to track kids from birth to age 10, and to use the data they collect on your child, video feed included, to track and predict personality. 

I did not sign up for any of this, I just want a simple video feed baby monitor but apparently in the world of big data, that no longer exists.

I will never buy another Nanit product, and you should not either

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: This app is unreliable. We have a strong internet connection, and have even upgraded our plan and yet, we do not get updated insights, access to clips in past activities, or summaries until days later. This system costs so much and yet we find ourselves using our other travel monitor that doesn’t require WiFi or a subscription because it’s more reliable.

reviews.title: Non-stop ads and pop-ups
reviews.text:
The app itself works well, however unless you pay for the subscription, you’ll be bombarded with non-stop ads and pop-ups to sign up for their subscription.

It seems like it’s every 5-10 times you go into the app which means it’s numerous times a day especially if you have multiple children / monitors.

reviews.title: Nightmare Setup & Fragile Build — Avoid if You Travel
reviews.text: Pairing this camera to a phone via Bluetooth and setting up the network is a nightmare. Be prepared to spend 30 minutes every time you try adding it to a new network—assuming you can even get it to work. It feels like it was designed to be set up only once. If you plan to use it in multiple locations or travel frequently with your kids, I recommend avoiding this camera. On top of that, it feels quite fragile.

reviews.title: Hidden fees
reviews.text: You have to pay a subscription to use it. Not a fan

reviews.title: unreliable, predatory pricing for multiple cameras.
reviews.text: The reliability is questionable, i’ve been using it for about 2 years and it will connect the majority if the time but considering this is used to monitor children I would expect to work everytime, and allow for remote remediation without having to physically unplug things in order to get it to work. If you want to use multiple cameras (which i did solely for the ability to connect from the web) forget it, you’ll need to pay through the nose for every camera. Oh and yeah, the web connection might as well not even exist as it’s so unreliable it’s embarrassing to call that a “paid feature” likely would have been better off with any other cheap chinese camera. Live and learn, last time i’m paying for this overpriced garbage. The breathing monitor and everything else also are useless and they constantly send false positives so we had to turn them off, ended up just monitoring manually. Very disappointed and now with baby #2 on the way i won’t be making the same mistake again. They’ll likely ban my account from app but at this point it doesn’t matter someone needs to be balance out these fake paid reviews.

reviews.title: Great but everything costs extra
reviews.text: The camera is great, but everything it says that it does, you have to pay extra for. Very frustrating…I’d have bought a camera with all features already included if I’d have known.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’m not usually the type to leave reviews, but I’m super disappointed in this camera/app. We originally bought a Nanit for my son in 2023. We loved being able to watch his breathing, though sometimes the app could be glitchy and we would need to force restart it for the camera to load or manually “locate” him for his band to work. Fast forward 3 years and another kid and the app is even worse. Switching between both kids almost always leads to one camera not loading and needing to force restart the app. The app often does not record a video history. The temperature gauge is extremely wrong on both cameras with one saying it’s way hotter in the room than it actually is and the other saying it’s colder than it is. Also, there is no way to get two cameras on one account, so each kid needs their own plan with no discount for multiples. For the amount of money that was already paid for the cameras themselves and the yearly fee for the memberships, you would think the app would work better. I’m really not sure what I’m even paying for. Unfortunately I would never recommend this camera for someone with more than one kid.

reviews.title: Avoid! SO overpriced to actually use
reviews.text: their subscription model is insane for the most basic of features

reviews.title: Great app but terrible icon update
reviews.text:
Why update your icon to a completely different colour scheme?

Please add an option to use the old one like monzo and other apps do.

reviews.title: Figures are wrong due to clock moving forward
reviews.text: Since the clocks in the UK moving forward the figures are an hour out and wrong making it seem toddler is not getting enough sleep.

reviews.title: Predatory design
reviews.text: Almost every featured locked behind a paywall, uses gross language as if written by the child “want to know when I woke up? Join insights!” Of all the things brought over the years for my kids this is the one I regret. Do research and invest in companies that don’t nickel and dime at every turn.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: The app is only saving recorded video sporadically. Nanit’s advice is to unplug and restart the camera. This results in a short term fix, until I’m looking back to find a special moment only to find once again Nanit has not recorded! I’m paying through the teeth for this as well. Grr.

reviews.title: Previously great but unreliable (Dec 2025)
reviews.text: Have used this app for years and used to love it, the background audio and fact that it would meet close whilst using other apps was the sole reason I invested in it. But since Dec 2025 the app is unstable, and will crash or close itself. Usually in the background but sometimes even when the app is open and on the screen. This is our man bat monitor, so to have it close whilst we are asleep is a scary prospect. Needs fixing ASAP, until now it’s been great. I figured it might be a simple fix but I’ve updated it 2-3 times in the last month and it’s still happening. For the price you pay it’s really not acceptable

reviews.title: iPad version is buggy and the bugs don’t seem to ever get addressed
reviews.text: The  iPad version lacks the “rotate” video option available in the iPhone version. The upshot of this is the video is always upside down. Additionally, there are lots of bugs (resizing video). Since I’ve used this every day on an iPad for five months, I’ve not seen any of these basic issues addressed, which is disappointing since the service you have to pay is so very expensive. Additionally (but maybe fix the iPad version first), I’m surprised/disappointed that there is no Apple TV version.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY THIS
reviews.text:
Firstly, we have full fibre broadband with speed running at 157.2
Mbps. No issues with other devices.
Yet the app is constantly having issues, it’s getting worse and worse over time.
It’s got to the point now where it’s taking us about 10 minutes to get the camera to connect to the app. Several times the camera has dropped out over night and we’ve not heard of little boy crying meaning he was left to cry for hours on end, we were gutted.  Also the nanit team never get back to you when you try and resolve these issues via any form of communication. Definitely would NOT recommend.

reviews.title: Unreliable so had to buy another
reviews.text: The internet connection drops frequently and without warning. This happened once in the middle of the night and then froze. The walls in our house are so thick when we woke up and reopened the app the baby was crying and we had no idea for how long. Completely pointless as a baby cam when you can get a cheap Bluetooth one that beeps if it ever disconnections.
